data.source: Pinterest production API v5 public-pin metrics plus GA4 and first-party database acquisition checks
caveats: Captured 24 hours and 36 seconds after public creation; the Pin has no recorded distribution yet.
Zero impressions cannot distinguish creative response from distribution, so this checkpoint is not a verdict on the Arm B headline or the Gratiator concept.
GA4 has no Pinterest source and no downstream product or affiliate click; the first-party database has zero product clicks in the trailing seven days.
Pinterest v3 and Sandbox are excluded. Revenue remains unavailable and is null.
